Valuable items

Careful handling
and specialist transport.

CODEM provides careful handling and specialist transport for valuable furniture, artwork, pianos and bulky items. Paintings, statues, wardrobes, tables and armchairs are prepared before moving to limit the risk of knocks.

Where corridors, stairs or lifts are too tight, a furniture lift or goods hoist can be arranged. Items are then secured and strapped down during transport.

  • Fragile, valuable or heavy items handled
  • Protection suited to size and type of item
  • Access and equipment assessed

Start my quote

The right care.
The right preparation.

01

Understand the item before moving it.

Type, dimensions, estimated weight and handling requirements: share the information you have. A piano needs a different assessment from a painting or an antique cabinet.

02

Choose suitable protection.

Blankets, corner protection, packing and securing methods are selected for the item and service. The aim is careful handling from collection to delivery.

03

Assess the entire route.

Doors, stairs, lifts, parking and final placement are assessed before equipment is confirmed. Mention any constraints in your first enquiry.

Let’s plan your move

Your questions.
A place to start.

I don’t know my moving volume. What should I do ?

Share your floor area, number of rooms and main furniture items. Select “I don’t know” in the quote form if needed. CODEM will assess the volume with you.

What if access is difficult ?

Tell us about floors, lifts, stairs and parking. Suitable equipment, including a furniture lift, is assessed against access conditions and any necessary permissions.

Can you pack fragile items ?

Dishes, artwork, mirrors and sensitive equipment can receive suitable protection as part of the agreed service. Mention any specialist items when you first contact us.

Are packing and unpacking included ?

This depends on the selected package and services. Your quote specifies what CODEM handles and what you prepare yourself.

Can I arrange temporary storage ?

Yes. Tell us the volume you need to store and the intended duration. Storage, collection and return arrangements are agreed with CODEM.

Which destinations do you serve ?

Paris, Greater Paris, France and European destinations including Spain, Portugal and Italy. Each route is assessed according to destination, volume and access.
